items.title: Colston Loveland: Makes first-down catch in preseason debut
items.description:
Loveland brought in one of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 27-9 preseason loss to the Bengals on Saturday.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Plays one series Saturday
items.description:

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Optimistic about Week 1 status
items.description:
Mahomes (knee) said during Saturday's preseason game at Tampa Bay that he's "extremely confident" he'll be available Week 1 against the Broncos on Monday, Sept. 14, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.
